dataset_name: BRACOL: A Brazilian Arabica Coffee Leaf Images Dataset

dataset_name: Uganda Coffee Leaf Disease Classification Dataset

dataset_name: Mendeley Tea Leaf Disease Dataset

dataset_name: Preprocessed Image Dataset of Indian Tea Leaves

dataset_name: BDRubberLeaf: Rubber Tree Leaf Diseases Dataset

dataset_name: Mendeley Sugarcane Leaf Image Dataset (7K)

dataset_name: Sugarcane Leaf Disease Dataset (Wardaruhin)

dataset_name: MCAD-DETR Tobacco Leaf Disease Dataset
